reasons.claim: Eligible species inside the polygon (0 m): Alectoria sarmentosa (VU, lichen, site-bound, forest-associated). Its listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of large or old trees, and changes in stand structure and tree species composition. The record is from 2026 with 5 m uncertainty.

Two NT site-bound forest species were also recorded at 0 m in 2026: Crossocalyx hellerianus and Felipes leucopellaeus. Both have felling-relevant threats. Two is below the three needed for the NT-count rule.
Completed felling overlaps only 0.7% of the polygon, so the site is not already felled.

Effort is below the county median (67 records within 1000 m vs median 75). Records inside the polygon come from only 2 observation days, so they likely reflect one or two visits rather than broad coverage.

uncertainties: The records come from only 2 observation days, so the full species set on the site is unknown.
Records show a species was recorded, not that it persists at the exact location or in the part to be felled.
Effort is below the county median at the 1000 m scale.
not_established: How much of the polygon the species occupy, or whether they will be affected by felling.
Stand age or condition, because no tool describes it.
That absence of other records means absence of other species.
Whether the felling is legal or appropriate.
next_action: Have an ecologist review the site. Check the 2026 records of Alectoria sarmentosa and the NT lichen and moss against the polygon, and consider a field inventory before felling begins.
